name: Shape Adaptive Blur
description: Edge preserving blur: neighbours weigh by distance and by their difference after a gaussian pre-filter.

params.name: luma_pre_filter_radius
params.description: Radius of the pre-filter that decides which neighbours look alike (`lpfr`)

params.name: luma_strength
params.description: Tolerance to value differences, in 8-bit levels: low keeps edges, high blurs across them (`ls`)
